description: This source file defines a test application factory for an ASP.NET Core minimal API project. It creates an in-memory test host with customized authentication schemes to facilitate testing endpoints that require authorization. The file includes a nested custom authentication handler that supplies a test principal with multiple roles to simulate authorized access in testing scenarios.

classes.name: TestAppFactory
classes.description: A specialized WebApplicationFactory used to set up an in-memory test server with custom authentication settings for testing the DataAssetBackend API.

classes.name: TestAuthHandler
classes.description: A custom authentication handler that provides a test identity with multiple roles for testing authorized endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure the web host for testing, setting environment and adding a mock authentication scheme.

methods.name: HandleAuthenticateAsync
methods.description: Provides a mocked authenticated principal with multiple roles for use in tests.
